sourceCoverage: Private Cardmarket archive accumulating; no public index dataset

limitations.title: Listing-price basis
limitations.body: Benchmarks use daily guide-style listing prices, not executed transaction prices.

limitations.title: Index publication pending
limitations.body: Official Cardmarket downloads are archived and checked daily. No index values, constituents, returns, or rankings are published until the required history and cutover review are complete.

limitations.title: Internal validation only
limitations.body: Synthetic fixtures may be used in automated software tests, but they are excluded from every public data export and user-facing calculation.

limitations.title: No raw price exposure
limitations.body: After publication, public files will expose derived index values, summaries, constituents, status, and reports only.

limitations.title: Language coverage
limitations.body: Each index includes every language represented in the official Cardmarket Europe catalogue. The source files do not provide a reliable language field, so no unsupported EN/DE-only claim is made.

limitations.title: Carry-forward rule
limitations.body: Missing constituent observations may be carried forward for a limited window and are counted in the public status surface.

checks.label: Manifest checksums
checks.detail: Every exported public JSON file is listed with a SHA-256 checksum.

checks.label: Static JSON contract
checks.detail: The first page load reads generated static files and does not require Supabase.

checks.label: Cardmarket source confirmation
checks.detail: Official price-guide and catalogue URLs for all ten configured games are verified by a scheduled schema and coverage check.

checks.label: Language universe
checks.detail: The methodology includes all languages represented in Cardmarket Europe and does not depend on an unavailable language field.

checks.label: Public index publication
checks.detail: No public index dataset exists yet. Publication requires sufficient archived history and a successful human cutover review.
